spans.s:
उरोगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
 1. Creeping, crawling, going on the belly
as a reptile.
 E. उरस् and गामिन् who goes.

उरोग्रह m. (-हः) Pain of the chest, pleurisy.
 E. उरस् and ग्रह what seizes.

उरोघात m. (-तः)
 1. Striking or beating the breast.
 2. Pain in the chest.
E. उरस् and घात a wound.

उरोज m. (-जः) The female breast.
 E. उरस् the breast, and ज produced.
